name: Firefox Syncserver
description: Firefox Syncserver (syncstorage-rs) is Mozilla's server behind Firefox Sync. It keeps your bookmarks, history, passwords, tabs and add-ons on your own hardware, encrypted by Firefox before upload, while you still sign in with a regular Mozilla account.

notes.text: There is no web interface. Before signing in to Sync, set identity.sync.tokenserver.uri in about:config to http://<IP>:8000/1.0/sync/1.5 and restart Firefox.
On Android, tap the logo in Settings > About Firefox until the debug menu appears, then set the custom Sync server there before signing in.

Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy or after an IP change, set SYNC_TOKENSERVER__INIT_NODE_URL in /opt/firefox-syncserver_data/.env to the new origin, restart firefox-syncserver and update the URL in Firefox.
